Brought to you by Doom Turtle, the developers of Ember Knights and our upcoming project, Welcome to Harmony.

 

When one bored Earthling teen is accidentally teleported to the far-flung Starkadian Empire, he lands face-first in the middle of an interdimensional battle between good and evil. Now it’s up to him and a ragtag bunch of misfits to defeat the shadowy, extradimensional armies of the Empire and become the heroes the system needs.

 

Welcome to Chapter 1

Legends of Starkadia: Chapter 1 delivers the complete, self-contained experience of Scrap World, the first planet in our epic interstellar saga. This chapter offers a polished 2-hour adventure packed with tactical combat, unique characters, and intense boss fights.

 

We want to be deeply transparent with our community: the complete 11-planet story of Starkadia is fully written, but as a small indie studio, the development cost to build the remaining 10 planets is a massive gamble. We have transitioned Chapter 1 to a paid model as an honest gauge of player interest. 100% of the revenue from this game and its supporter bundles goes directly into a dedicated studio bucket to recoup our development costs and fund the production of future chapters.

 

Key Features:

  • Strategic turn-based combat with quick-time events (QTEs) for both offense and defense.

  • Explore the scrap-reclaimed dunes, hidden secrets, and side missions of Scrap World.

  • Unlock and play as quirky characters, each with their own unique attributes and combat skills.

  • Support an independent studio's dream to build a massive, 11-planet universe piece by piece.

 

Thank you for backing Chapter 1 and standing with our studio. Your purchase is a direct vote to help us keep building the galaxy!
